name: distribution-solution
body: Distribution: the release pipeline and package channels are repo/CI artefacts (GitHub Actions YAML, a Ruby formula, a Scoop JSON manifest, docs), not Go code, so they carry no implemented-by edges. Push/tag rule (global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag): pushing to the remote and creating tags require explicit, per-action human consent; an agent acts only under that consent, and with it may perform any push/tag operation the human asked for (including force-push and moving/overwriting/deleting a tag). The release workflow's manifest-only commit (version/URL/checksum updates under `Formula/` and `bucket/`) is the one carve-out: its writes stay manifest-only and it reacts to a consented tag, so code pushes and tag creation remain the maintainer's actions.
